fields.Name: Sales: Bookings by Period
fields.UserQuestion: What did we book by month, quarter or year — and what did we lose alongside it?
fields.Description: Closed-won amount by period (master plan §9.3 measure 4), with losses reported beside it so a rising bookings figure and a falling win rate cannot be mistaken for each other. One row per deal, so no attribution question arises and nothing can be double-counted.
fields.TechnicalDescription: Grain: Deal. Date dimension: ActualCloseDate — bookings belong to the period a deal actually closed in, which differs from expected for every deal that slipped. Won/Lost from the IsWon / IsLost flags. Granularity is a Nunjucks branch selecting one of three fixed DATEFROMPARTS expressions, so no caller string reaches a DATEPART argument.

fields.Name: CompanyID
fields.Description: Selling company. Omit for every company. Deal.CompanyID is server-stamped from the pipeline, so it is always present and never needs a fallback.

fields.Name: PipelineID
fields.Description: One pipeline. Omit for all pipelines.

fields.Name: PeriodStart
fields.Description: Inclusive start of the window. Omit for no lower bound.

fields.Name: PeriodEnd
fields.Description: Inclusive end of the window. Omit for no upper bound.

fields.Name: Granularity
fields.Description: month (default), quarter, or year. A branch selects one of three fixed expressions; the value never enters SQL text.
